en.description:
Answer Arabic trivia and play with friends in Fi6een فطين. Try a solo round as a guest, or sign in, create a private room and share its code. The interface, questions and word content are in Arabic.

TRIVIA AND DAILY CHALLENGES
Answer quiz questions across different topics. Try a round where you give your own answer before revealing the solution, or play the daily challenge.

JACKAROO
Choose classic or fast Jackaroo. Play offline against computer opponents, or join an online table with friends. Pick your cards, move your marbles and get them safely home.

KUWAITI WORD GAMES
• Crossword: solve clues and connect the words.
• Hangman: guess the hidden word before your attempts run out.
• Missing Proverb: complete Kuwaiti proverbs.
• First Letter and Speed: find suitable words before time runs out.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a private room and share its code, or try Royale competitions. Online play requires an account and internet access. Opponent availability and waiting times depend on players online.

GUEST PLAY AND CREDITS
Try solo games as a guest. Trial limits are shown in the app; some games or options require credits or Plus. Credits can be purchased without a subscription. Costs are shown before purchase.

Fi6een PLUS
Plus is an optional monthly subscription with topic selection, a profile photo, and 50 credits with the first paid subscription and each paid monthly renewal. It removes ads when ads are enabled. Local pricing and benefits are shown before purchase confirmation.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically each month unless renewal is cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in Apple subscription settings. Restore purchases from the Plus screen. Deleting the app or your Fi6een account does not cancel the subscription.

APPLE WATCH
Play the daily challenge, Missing Proverb and Hangman on a compatible Apple Watch after linking your account.

ACCOUNT DELETION
To permanently delete your account, open Profile (ملفي), then Account & Privacy (الحساب والخصوصية), choose Delete my account (احذف حسابي), and confirm deletion.

Privacy: https://fi6een.com/privacy
Terms: https://fi6een.com/terms
Account deletion: https://fi6een.com/delete-account
Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

ja.trackName: Fi6een: アラビア語クイズ
ja.description:
Fi6een فطينでアラビア語のクイズに答えて、友達と一緒に遊ぼう。

Jackaroo、クイズ、クウェートの言葉を使ったパズルを楽しもう。画面表示、問題、単語はアラビア語です。ゲストとして1人で遊べます。オンライン対戦にはアカウントとインターネット接続が必要です。Plusは自動更新の任意の月額サブスクリプションです。ストアのアカウントで管理・解約できます。アプリを削除しても解約されません。

Fi6een فطين
• さまざまなテーマのクイズに答えたり、毎日のチャレンジに挑戦したりできます。
• クロスワードを解き、ハングマンで単語を当て、クウェートのことわざを完成させましょう。
• Jackarooはクラシックと高速モードから選択。オフラインでコンピューターと対戦したり、オンラインの卓に参加したりできます。
• 非公開ルームを作り、コードを友達に共有できます。オンラインプレイにはアカウントとインターネット接続が必要です。

https://fi6een.com/privacy
https://fi6een.com/terms

ja.releaseNotes: 新機能：ハングマンの1対1対戦と、最大50人で遊べるライブの頭文字ゲーム。オンラインの友だちを招待するか、ルームのリンクを共有しよう。友だちはリンクやQRコードで追加できます。まずゲームを選んで、それから遊び方を選ぼう。

de.description:
Fi6een فطين: Beantworte Quizfragen auf Arabisch und spiele mit Freunden.

Spiele Jackaroo, beantworte Quizfragen und löse kuwaitische Worträtsel. Oberfläche, Fragen und Wörter sind auf Arabisch. Spiele allein als Gast; für Online-Spiele brauchst du ein Konto und Internet. Plus ist ein optionales Monatsabo mit automatischer Verlängerung. Verwalte oder kündige es in deinem Store-Konto. Das Löschen der App kündigt das Abo nicht.

Fi6een فطين
• Beantworte Quizfragen aus verschiedenen Themen oder spiele die tägliche Herausforderung.
• Löse Kreuzworträtsel, errate das gesuchte Wort beim Galgenmännchen und vervollständige kuwaitische Sprichwörter.
• Wähle klassisches oder schnelles Jackaroo: offline gegen den Computer oder online am Spieltisch.
• Erstelle einen privaten Raum und teile den Code mit Freunden. Online-Spiele benötigen ein Konto und Internet.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Introducing Fi6een: a new name and look, Jackaroo, and layouts adapted for iPad.
Jackaroo improvements and new categories for the word games.
Fi6een is now on Apple Watch: play the daily challenge, Missing Proverb and Hangman from your wrist, with the same account and points. Also includes layout fixes across the games.
TV games are now a full show: team ladders, sound effects and a host voice, with awards at the end of the night. Invite links and QR codes now open the game directly.

Every game now has its own doors: play people now, play with friends, or enter Royale. Crossword has its own keyboard so you see the whole puzzle, Proverb moves faster, and Jackaroo now plays on your TV. Girls and kids questions appear only when you pick them.

New: Hangman 1v1 duels and live First Letter with up to 50 players. Invite friends who are online or share a room link, and add friends with a link or QR code. Pick a game first, then choose how to play.
